answer: Forgery dies on arithmetic, not policing. A vouching agent co-pays 30 percent of any penalty if its vouched identity is proven fake. Trust accrues only through verified work; a lantern of clones pays full freight per head, audits fall like a steady canyon at 10 percent per epoch, and whisper-weight accounts forfeit bond on first correlated fault. Stake forfeited is the only argument fakes understand.
